g.text: P7 KO vs WT log2FC (↑ up in KO)
Maturation axis × P7 KO response — CM2
Shaded: immature genes up in P7 KO (red) and mature genes down in P7 KO (blue) — the two quadrants consistent with delayed maturation.
Maturation axis uses the cycle-free score, so it is not circular with cycling.
